name: Residente Temporal Pensionado

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a lifetime pension of at least USD 1,000 per month, from a government, private, or international pension source, authenticated by the paying institution.
requirements.fix_path: Document a qualifying lifetime pension of USD 1,000+/month.

requirements.blocker_text: Pensionado status holders may not perform remunerated work (manual or intellectual) in Costa Rica -- an ongoing restriction of the status rather than a qualifying eligibility test, so not modelled as a hard pass/fail gate.

sources.title: Defensoría de los Habitantes de la República (dhr.go.cr) -- Ley General de Migración y Extranjería No. 8764, Título VI, Article 79 (pensionado category, USD 1,000 minimum stated directly)
Consortium Legal -- Reglamento de la Ley 9996 (investor/rentista/pensionado work restriction, quoted from the regulation)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Costa Rica's initial build. Unlike cr_rentista, the USD 1,000/month figure here is confirmed directly at tier-1 (dhr.go.cr, the official Ombudsman's office, quoting Article 79 of the actual migration law) -- the source text lists pensionados among Article 79's ten temporary-resident subcategories with the amount stated inline. pr_after_months (36) reflects the general 3-consecutive-years route to permanent residence (Article 78).
